title: Account: user deleted v1
description: DRAFT, proposed by account, waits for payment, project and provisioning. Owner: account (owner's decision, DECISIONS.md User 4, 10 November 2026). A user's Keycloak account was deleted: user-service closed the account (the row stays, marked deleted, and its email is free for a new sign-up, which gets a NEW user_id; no data moves to it). Consumers close what they hold for this user_id (Payment ends the subscription, Project and Provisioning take the websites offline). Sent once per account, after the database commit, when user-service's scheduled Keycloak check first finds Keycloak's own "User not found" for it, or when a new sign-up with the same email finds the old Keycloak user gone. deleted_at is when user-service found it gone (Keycloak does not say when it was deleted). A repeat is harmless: consumers record message_id or user_id once. No name and no email. Like the other account events, no project_id (open point in the README). Exchange account.events, routing key account.user_deleted.v1 (= message_type), persistent, application/json, AMQP type = message_type.
